issue_context.summary: FancyZones reportedly cannot snap a non-elevated window while PowerToys is elevated unless the secondary mouse button is held.
known_information: Report is PowerToys 0.86.0 and says PowerToys runs as administrator.
It concerns snapping a window at a different privilege level.
Current DraggingState re-seeds Shift at drag start because raw input can miss transitions while an elevated window owns input.
inferences: If still reproducible, the remaining gap may be the secondary-button path or another integrity-level transition; the report does not establish this.
issue_context.analysis: Current source refreshes one relevant state, but that is not proof of a shipped fix. Confirm current-release behavior and the exact input path.
initial_investigation: DraggingState::Enable re-seeds Shift; UpdateDraggingState combines Shift and secondary-button state: src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/DraggingState.cpp.
Related issue #23282 does not establish equivalence.

comment.body: Thanks for reporting the mixed-elevation case on 0.86.0. Current FancyZones source refreshes Shift when a drag starts because elevated foreground windows can hide raw-input transitions, but that does not establish whether the released build fixes your exact path. Please confirm whether it still happens on the current PowerToys version and specify the target app’s elevation plus the exact keys/buttons used (Shift-drag or secondary-button drag). That will show whether another input-state path remains.
